verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a public REST API for syncs, models, sources and destinations. It has bearer-token auth, a base URL, rate limits and TLS requirements, and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec (36 paths) that renders as the API reference. Keys can also be scoped to restricted roles specifically for AI tools. The probe 404s at hightouch.com OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served from api.hightouch.io. Missing for 10: no evidence that the REST API covers audiences, journeys or other Customer Studio/AI Decisioning resources (those appear only via the MCP server), no live try-it runner, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
